page.body:
LEADS

Estimated reading: 1 minute 835 views

Turn interest into opportunity! Master the art of managing leads, from direct inquiries to MLS agency referrals. 

PropertyList.es fuels your sales pipeline with a powerful lead generation system:

All captured leads are automatically converted into contacts, ready to be added to your pipeline.

  • MLS LEADS: Connect with qualified clients referred by fellow agents on the MLS platform.
  • MICROSITE LEADS: Capture enquiries from direct potential clients through your Branded MicroSite.
  • PORTAL LEADS: PropertyList.es public property portal generates qualified direct leads right to you!

    No matter where they come from, all your leads are conveniently collected in one place for easy management, follow-up and overview.

This comprehensive approach ensures a steady stream of leads being managed easily, allowing you to focus on converting them into happy clients.

Happy Hunting!
